quotes.title: HD 50554
quotes.card: HD 50554 is a single, Sun-like star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Gemini.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of +6.84, which makes it a 7th magnitude star; it is not visible to the naked eye, but can be viewed with binoculars or a telescope.
